```lean
theorem lg_target (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) : a / b + b / c + c / a ≥ 3 := by
  have h1 : (a / b + b / c + c / a) / 3 ≥ 1 :=
    Real.arithmeticoGeometricMean (a / b) (b / c) (c / a).geometric_mean_le_arithmetic_mean
  rw [mul_one, mul_div_right] at h1
  exact h1
```
